counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行 ESM 模型进行蛋白质结构预测与推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要预测蛋白质结构或运行 ESM 模型推理。
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and run ESM model inference
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict protein structures or run ESM model inference.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你编写和讲解使用 esm Python 包的蛋白质建模代码:用 ESM3 生成或补全序列、预测结构,用 ESM C 计算嵌入,并通过 Forge/Biohub 调用云端模型。
howto.when: 当任务直接涉及 esm Python SDK、ESM3 或 ESMC 模型,或 Forge/Biohub 推理客户端等蛋白质建模工作时触发。

say.text: 用 esm 的 ESM3 模型补全序列 MPRT___KEND,给出代码。
帮我把这个 PDB 结构做逆折叠,设计新序列。
say.note: Claude 会写出从结构生成序列的代码。

say.text: 用 ESMC 计算这三条蛋白质序列的嵌入。
say.note: Claude 会提供批量计算嵌入的代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you write and explain protein-modeling code using the `esm` package: ESM3 for sequence generation/completion and structure prediction, ESM C for embeddings, and Forge/Biohub for cloud inference.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Use ESM3 to complete the sequence MPRT___KEND and show code.
say_en.note: Claude will give an ESM3 Python completion example.

say_en.text: Take this PDB structure and do inverse folding to design a new sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will show code that generates a sequence from the structure.

say_en.text: Compute embeddings for these three protein sequences with ESMC.
say_en.note: Claude will provide batch embedding code.
